mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3 years remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting central bank policy accommodation and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by >0.5pp over 3 months, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous expansion in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer demand and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing activity and impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3 years in late-cycle periods is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500,000 units per month signals contraction in residential construction, a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and deceleration in job growth (PAYEMS) below 50,000 per month signal deteriorating labor market conditions, associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and earnings concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is rising and PAYEMS < 50.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 225.0 signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0, or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
